Document: - 1. If you are not an antagonist, you may only break someone out of the Security department (the Brig) if the damage to the station is insignificant. You may only release someone from permanent confinement (Perma) with an administrator's permission. - 2. Helping antagonists is allowed to some extent, but it should be "passive" assistance and you must have good reasons for it. Opening an airlock for an antagonist or turning a blind eye to suspicious activity is acceptable. Giving them a bomb is not.
